genius.notes: Forest Road is the named protocol operator/originator, but the exact token-contracting legal entity is not established by the reviewed public legal page. Public how-to documentation says USDfr itself does not earn yield and permits transfers and secondary Uniswap purchases by nonblocked wallets; sUSDfr is a separate yield-bearing token. Primary minting and redemption use USDC at 1:1, with instant redemption limited to idle liquidity. GENIUS section 2(22)(A)(ii)(I) requires an issuer obligation to redeem a fixed amount of monetary value and excludes redemption solely into a digital asset denominated in that amount; the private agreements are needed to establish any additional dollar obligation and securities characterization. Public transparency describes idle USDC and credit principal, but no independent current balances or monthly accountant report were exposed. Dated public-source review found no GENIUS authorization for USDfr or the named Forest Road project; this bounded negative does not establish illegality or an exact legal issuer. MiCA cannot be positively classified: public documents defer legal characterization and geographic eligibility to private onboarding materials; generic wallet availability and register absence do not prove an EU offer or an exclusion.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of October 7, 2026, no public token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified authorization, official GENIUS application or registered foreign-issuer exception was located for USDfr or the publicly named Forest Road project. Rulemaking and unrelated banking applications are not issuer approvals. The private legal issuer and securities/payment-obligation characterization remain unresolved, so this is a limited public-evidence finding rather than a statement that an unidentified legal obligor has no licenses.
